thread:
Ravi (Finance): Quick sync: planning a small preflight for the grandfathering rollout. Objective: ensure invoice previews, CSV exports, and proration behave before any customer-facing flips. Need owners for sample export, metering tag, comms, and rollback criteria.

Jules (Billing): I can handle the sample CSV + schema check. Please include a `grandfathered` column and `pricing_path` so downstream jobs can filter.

Noor (RevOps): I'll draft preview copy and a short FAQ. For preflight we surface "preview only" text in the billing UI. Recommend 72h notice for any live change.

Elena (Product): From API side add `rate_version` and `grandfathered` to /account and /billing endpoints. Also request a tiny eval that stresses system messages so token accounting is validated.

Alden (Billing Ops): Metering plan: tag staging accounts with `acct.meta.gf_cohort=v1`, emit `grandfathered:true` on staged aggregates via feature flag. Proration: annual customers remain on legacy until renewal unless opt-in. I'll add an invoicer guard.

Ravi (Finance): Runbook highlights:
- Tag cohorts in staging + smoke test
- Emit `grandfathered` flag in staging metering for 14 days
- Produce invoice_preview CSV (include grandfathered + rate_version) and run csv diff
- Canary: 0.5% legacy-monthly for 24h, monitor invoice_preview_count, refunds_count, token_delta_pct
- Block if refunds_count > 3 or token_delta_pct > 6% or any preview accidentally becomes live
- Rollback: toggle off cohort tags + regenerate previews + auto-send support notices if invoices were impacted

Jules (Billing): I'll post CSV sample by EOD: columns account_id,billing_start,billing_end,plan,applied_rate,grandfathered,pricing_path,invoice_preview_amount,tokens_billed. Will run `csvdiff` and surface diffs.

Noor (RevOps): Drafts incoming; will include banner copy: "Billing preview: no charges applied" and opt-in flow docs.

BillingBot: Ticket FIN-7320 created by Ravi (Finance): "grandfathering preflight - previews & gating". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-7320

Elena (Product): Reminder: include the system-message eval. In past rollouts, batching/quantization changes caused ~4-6% token shifts.

Alden (Billing Ops): Will add reconcile job to compare staged tokens vs prod baseline and alert on >6% divergence to #billing-ops. Also will ensure preview_only flag prevents any invoice from reaching payment processor.

Ravi (Finance): Thanks. Meeting tomorrow 10:00 to sign off canary window. Action items: Jules => CSV sample, Alden => feature flag + emitter, Noor => comms + banner, Elena => API PR + eval set.
